{{Top|leg|title=MCT ''Nuurglat''}}
The '''MCT''' '''''Nuurglat''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used by the [[Metatheran Cartel]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Confederation Rock Rush]] in c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the ''Nuurglat'' traveled into the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] carrying a crew of five [[Caarite]]s that were led by the Cartel executive [[Niim Stroolg]], and they landed it in a cavern inside an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. However, their arrival awoke a [[shadow creature]] that lay dormant within the asteroid, and it wrecked the ''Nuurglat'' and drove the Caarites to [[Death/Legends|kill]] themselves.
